card.name: Trough and peak drug level terms
card.fires_on: Words naming a measured blood level, such as trough, peak, Cmin and steady-state, right before the word concentration or level in drug monitoring text.

modes.label: Trough/peak wording
modes.description: The word trough, peak or part of it (T-rough) naming when a blood sample is taken or what level is targeted.
modes.example: In order to measure the<< peak>> concentration, a serum sample should be drawn

modes.label: Cmin and steady-state
modes.description: Pharmacokinetic terms like Cmin or steady-state, or the word concentrations itself, in dose-adjustment or interaction text.
modes.example: Nevirapine ↓ nelfinavir (C<< min>> ) Concentrations of nelfin
